blocks.heading: Start with consulting if
paragraphs: You are not sure which AI projects to prioritize, you need an internal business case for AI investment, you need an independent assessment of AI systems already running, or you need expert guidance on vendor selection.

blocks.heading: Start with discovery if
paragraphs: You know the business problem but need to validate the AI approach, want a fixed-price development contract but need to define scope first, or have concerns about data quality or access.

blocks.heading: Start with development if
paragraphs: You know what you want to build, you have executive alignment and budget, your data situation is understood, and you need a production system rather than a strategy document.

blocks.heading: Why fixed-price consulting
paragraphs: Time-and-materials billing gives clients no protection against scope creep. Every ClickMasters consulting engagement has a fixed total price with defined deliverables; if it takes longer than planned, we absorb the additional time.

items.question: How much does AI consulting cost?
items.answer: $200–$400/hr for boutique AI consultants and $15,000–$60,000 for structured project engagements. Big Four enterprise strategy engagements typically run $100,000–$500,000+.

items.question: How long does an AI consulting engagement take?
items.answer: 3–20 weeks for strategy and roadmap work. Discovery engagements: 3–6 weeks. Retainer advisory is ongoing monthly.

items.question: Do you provide AI consulting without development?
items.answer: Yes — strategy, discovery and advisory engagements are available as standalone services without committing to ClickMasters for development.

items.question: What does a ClickMasters AI Discovery include?
items.answer: Data audit, use-case validation, architecture recommendation, risk identification and a fixed-price development proposal for the validated project scope. Discovery clients who proceed to development receive credit for the Discovery investment.

items.question: What's the difference between hourly advisory and a fixed-price engagement?
items.answer: Hourly advisory ($200–$400/hr) suits ad hoc questions and light-touch ongoing guidance. Fixed-price engagements suit a defined scope with a specific deliverable and give you cost certainty upfront.

items.question: Is AI consulting worth the investment?
items.answer: For organizations making $200K+ AI investment decisions, a strategy engagement that prevents a bad vendor choice or the wrong AI approach usually pays for itself. With smaller AI budgets, a lighter-weight approach with vendor input is often enough — we will tell you which applies.

sections.heading: Get a fixed-price proposal for your AI decision
sections.text: Tell us the decision you need to make or the initiative you want to validate. A senior practitioner will reply within one business day with a recommended engagement and fixed price.
